verdict.rationale: Hooks run your code on agent events and can block dangerous operations, such as destructive shell commands, before they execute. The canUseTool callback and permission rules gate tool use at runtime, and structured outputs validate the final output against a schema. These controls are aimed mainly at tool actions rather than at the content of prompts and responses. Missing for 10: input guardrails that inspect or block user prompt content, output guardrails that transform or redact unsafe model text, any documented transform/rewrite capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
